decision_question: Should evidence_ranges_overlap consult the canonical character range when one side declares no region identity?

adopt_correction_if: every pair present in the sealed package receives an identical decision under both matchers
the grounding and evaluation test suites return the same failures before and after
decision_rule.otherwise: The contract is left unchanged and selection 003's verdict stands as the final word.

defect.correction: Compare region identities only when both sides declare one; otherwise fall through to the canonical character range.
defect.current: if observed.region_id is not None or expected.region_id is not None: return observed.region_id == expected.region_id
defect.statement: If either side carries a region identity the canonical character range is never consulted. A citation whose source artifact, version, sha256 and character range all match the gold reference exactly is scored as a miss whenever exactly one of the two declares a region.
defect.why_wrong_independent_of_any_result: The comparison is asymmetric in a way nothing justifies. Two references to the same bytes of the same version of the same artifact are the same evidence. A region identity is additional provenance, so it can only refine a match that the range already establishes, never contradict one that neither side disputes. As written, supplying more provenance than the gold declares makes a correct citation score worse than supplying less, which no evaluation contract should reward.

disclosure.consequence: Selection 003's verdict is not amended. The re-run is registered separately as selection 004 so the original verdict and the corrected one are both readable.
disclosure.required_by: the loop's rule for changing the instrument itself
disclosure.statement: This defect was found while investigating dominance-scoped-ambiguity-safe-v3, a candidate that benefits from the correction. Under registered scoring that candidate ties the incumbent at 16.00%; under range matching it reaches 50.00% against the incumbent's 36.80%. The correction was not sought in order to promote it, but it was found in the course of trying to, and that ordering is recorded here rather than omitted.

no_recorded_result_changes.conclusion: The correction is the identity map on the sealed package. No recorded result moves.

scope_limits: This corrects a measurement contract, not the product.
The sealed 10,000-case benchmark is not read, rerun, or rescored.
Adopting the correction licenses no promotion by itself; a promotion still needs its own registered comparison.
